searchText: Great to hear, Daniel. Thanks for the very clear statement! Has there been any further discussion/progress on launching the "full EOF" Shandong replacement testnet? We are ready to go on Erigon and have WIP on Besu. https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/eof1-checklist <@425279588009246720> ? How many unique "delpoyer" contracts are there that deploy contracts that have `SELFDESTRUCT` in them? > Total of 2058022 existing selfdestructable contracts were created by creators with only CREATE2 in their bytecode. I'm curious of the count of contracts that did the deployment, rather than the count of deployed contracts.
